list.name: environment
list.label: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM ${db}.events_core WHERE project_id = '${project}' AND start_time > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY ORDER BY environment

panels.title: 서비스별 트래픽 (KST 일)
panels.description: root observation 수 = trace 수. 하루 경계는 Asia/Seoul 자정.

targets.rawSql:
-- p1 · traces per KST day per service (root observations only: one row per trace)
-- events_core: PRIMARY KEY (project_id, toStartOfMinute(start_time), …), so the project and the
-- time filter prune granules before anything is read.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(start_time, 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
    service_name,
    count() AS traces
FROM ${db}.events_core
WHERE project_id = '${project}'
  AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND parent_span_id = ''
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time, service_name
ORDER BY time, service_name

panels.title: 팀별 모델 비용 (KRW, KST 일)
panels.description: Langfuse가 계산한 USD 비용 × 환율 변수 krw_per_usd.

targets.rawSql:
-- p3 · model cost per KST day per team, in KRW (Langfuse's USD cost × the krw_per_usd variable)
-- `team` is trace metadata (langfuse.trace.metadata.team); v4 copies it onto every observation,
-- so no join back to the trace is needed.
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(start_time, 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
    metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names, 'team')] AS team,
    round(sum(calculated_total_cost) * ${krw_per_usd}, 0) AS cost_krw
FROM ${db}.events_core
WHERE project_id = '${project}'
  AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND type = 'GENERATION'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time, team
ORDER BY time, team

panels.title: 서비스별 지연 p50 / p95 (초, KST 일)

targets.rawSql:
-- p2 · trace latency p50 / p95 per KST day per service, in seconds (root observation duration)
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(start_time, 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
    service_name,
    round(quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) / 1000, 2) AS p50,
    round(quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) / 1000, 2) AS p95
FROM ${db}.events_core
WHERE project_id = '${project}'
  AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND parent_span_id = ''
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time, service_name
ORDER BY time, service_name

panels.title: 점수 추이: judge 평균 · 👍 비율 (KST 일)
panels.description: judge-faithfulness 평균과 user-feedback 1 비율. 서비스는 trace의 root observation에서.

targets.rawSql:
-- p7 · score trend per KST day per service: judge-faithfulness average and user-feedback 👍 rate
-- Scores carry no service, so the trace's root observation supplies it (join on trace_id).
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(s.timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
    t.service_name AS service,
    round(avgIf(s.value, s.name = 'judge-faithfulness'), 3) AS judge_avg,
    round(avgIf(s.value, s.name = 'user-feedback'), 3) AS thumbs_up_rate
FROM ${db}.scores AS s
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT trace_id, service_name
    FROM ${db}.events_core
    WHERE project_id = '${project}'
      AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
      AND parent_span_id = ''
      AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
) AS t ON t.trace_id = s.trace_id
WHERE s.project_id = '${project}'
  AND s.name IN ('judge-faithfulness', 'user-feedback')
  AND $__timeFilter(s.timestamp)
GROUP BY time, service
ORDER BY time, service

panels.title: 프롬프트 버전별 실패율 · judge 점수
panels.description: generation의 level = ERROR 비율. judge_avg는 같은 trace의 judge-faithfulness 평균.

targets.rawSql:
-- p4 · failure rate and judge score per prompt version (generations; ERROR level = failed)
SELECT
    prompt_name AS prompt,
    prompt_version AS version,
    formatDateTime(min(g.start_time), '%m-%d %H:%i', 'Asia/Seoul') AS first_seen_kst,
    count() AS generations,
    countIf(level = 'ERROR') AS failed,
    round(100 * countIf(level = 'ERROR') / count(), 2) AS failure_pct,
    round(avg(j.judge), 3) AS judge_avg
FROM ${db}.events_core AS g
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT trace_id, avg(value) AS judge
    FROM ${db}.scores
    WHERE project_id = '${project}'
      AND name = 'judge-faithfulness'
      AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    GROUP BY trace_id
) AS j ON j.trace_id = g.trace_id
WHERE g.project_id = '${project}'
  AND g.environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND g.type = 'GENERATION'
  AND g.prompt_name != ''
  AND $__timeFilter(g.start_time)
GROUP BY prompt, version
ORDER BY prompt, version
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1  -- traces without a judge score stay NULL, not 0

panels.title: 느린 trace 20개
panels.description: trace_id를 누르면 Langfuse trace 화면이 열린다.

targets.rawSql:
-- p5 · the 20 slowest traces in range; trace_id links back to the Langfuse trace page
SELECT
    trace_id,
    formatDateTime(start_time, '%m-%d %H:%i:%S', 'Asia/Seoul') AS start_kst,
    service_name AS service,
    user_id,
    round(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time) / 1000, 2) AS seconds,
    level,
    status_message
FROM ${db}.events_core
WHERE project_id = '${project}'
  AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND parent_span_id = ''
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
ORDER BY seconds DESC, trace_id
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 비싼 trace 20개 (KRW)
panels.description: trace_id를 누르면 Langfuse trace 화면이 열린다.

targets.rawSql:
-- p6 · the 20 costliest traces in range, in KRW (sum over the trace's generations)
SELECT
    trace_id,
    formatDateTime(min(start_time), '%m-%d %H:%i:%S', 'Asia/Seoul') AS start_kst,
    any(service_name) AS service,
    any(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names, 'team')]) AS team,
    any(user_id) AS user_id,
    sum(usage_details['input']) AS input_tokens,
    sum(usage_details['output']) AS output_tokens,
    round(sum(calculated_total_cost) * ${krw_per_usd}, 1) AS cost_krw
FROM ${db}.events_core
WHERE project_id = '${project}'
  AND environment IN (${environment:singlequote})
  AND type = 'GENERATION'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY trace_id
ORDER BY cost_krw DESC, trace_id
LIMIT 20
